decision.inner_loop_A1: WEAK_POSITIVE_UNRESOLVED — retained as a multi-seed candidate
decision.task_selector_A2: REJECTED — worse than A1 on every metric at every k

arm_matching.verified: configs differ in exactly {arm, inner_steps, inner_lr, task_selection}
arm_matching.baseline_equivalence: A0 at inner_steps=0 reproduces the production episode loss to 2e-5 on all seven terms at every k, each term verified non-zero
arm_matching.readout_identity: the re-implemented readout equals InteractionGrammarModel.encode's endpoint bitwise

adaptable_scope.inner_lr_selection: meta_train component folds against the frozen A0 checkpoint; meta_val not read

G2_A2_beats_A1.note: A2 is worse than A1 on MSE, Pearson, Spearman and CI at every k. Uniform direction, no interval resolved.

G4_correct_support_beats_permuted_and_ma.note: every one of these intervals excludes zero

G5_improvement_grows_with_support.cause: the inner loop competes with the incumbent Tanimoto residual transport for the same support information; as k rises transport already captures it

G6_no_leakage.query_labels: structurally excluded; tested by perturbing query labels and asserting bitwise-identical predictions
G6_no_leakage.meta_val_checkpoint_selection: present but identical in all three arms, so it cannot create a between-arm difference

k1_shape_versus_level.question: is the k=1 gain task-specific shape adaptation or a scalar level shift?
k1_shape_versus_level.answer: NOT DISTINGUISHABLE FROM A LEVEL SHIFT. A pure scalar bias update recovers 81% of the k=1 gain, and the shape residual is unresolved.

protein_specificity.note: A1 shows small but RESOLVED protein specificity at k=2,3,5 — the first resolved wrong-protein gap in this project's record. A2 destroys it: its gaps are zero to four decimals.

inner_loop_conditioning.definition: alpha = 2 * inner_lr * ||h||^2 at k=1; post-step residual is (1 - alpha) times the pre-step residual
inner_loop_conditioning.explains: A0 overshoots on 100% of episodes, so each inner step flips the residual sign with magnitude 0.514. Its k=1 sweep alternates exactly as predicted: steps0 1.5352, steps1 2.8626, steps2 1.4349, steps3 2.2049 — odd bad, even good, decaying. Training with the loop pushed alpha 6.3x down into the stable contraction region.
inner_loop_conditioning.consequence: the inner loop cannot be bolted onto an already-trained model; it must be trained with.

task_selection_diagnosis.diagnosis: The selector worked as designed and that is why it failed. It concentrated on tasks whose support and query gradients almost perfectly agree (0.99 against a 0.66 population mean) — the easy, redundant tasks where support already predicts query. Training on them cost task diversity, cost 2.33x the encoder forwards, and eliminated the protein specificity A1 had.

cost.wall_time_note: A0's wall time is inflated by a concurrent test-suite run; forward count is the clean cost measure
cost.inner_loop_encoder_cost: zero — the adapted scope is downstream of the encoder, so A1 uses exactly as many encoder passes as A0

k0_sanity.note: A0 lands inside the recorded incumbent band, so the baseline reproduced

bugs_found_and_fixed: the inner loop could not run under torch.no_grad(), which is how evaluation calls it — support adaptation at inference was structurally impossible until an explicit enable_grad scope was added
the first trainer silently dropped three auxiliary loss terms, which would have turned any A1 gain into 'the inner loop recovers what we deleted'
Python's built-in hash() was reintroduced for a permutation seed (the PYTHONHASHSEED defect repaired in Stage R); caught before any run
paired() compared each condition against itself, making every counterfactual an exact zero that looked like a clean null
two trainers wrote to one output directory after a killed shell wrapper walked on to the next arm; a fail-closed guard now prevents it
next_step_if_pursued: A1 is a weak unresolved positive worth three matched seeds. Do not add architectural complexity: the measured obstacles are (a) competition with the existing Tanimoto transport, which explains the shrinking gain with k, and (b) a k=1 effect that is 81% a level shift.

meta_test.isolation: logical exclusion after parsing; process-isolation incident remains open
